_comment: Human-written context the weekly job blends with GitHub activity. Keys are repo names (owner/name, or bare name for your own). Anything not listed here is described from commit subjects alone, which reads thin. Edit this file when you start something new.

abhinavaditya811/coo.blurb: A kernel that maps a natural-language request onto an ordered plan of pre-defined capabilities and runs them on a Mac over HTTP. The model only selects capabilities and fills their parameters, never writes the code that executes, so there is no script-injection surface. Splits into an always-on edge and a Mac node so a request still gets an honest answer while the Mac is asleep.

abhinavaditya811/settl.blurb: An outreach and recovery engine that chases overdue invoices for freelancers and small businesses. It decides timing, tone, and channel, drafts in the customer's voice, clears a hard compliance gate, then reconciles the outcome. The decision core is deterministic and runs offline with no API keys.

_past.blurb: End-to-end HR analytics pipeline using hybrid LLM/SLM intelligence to pull qualitative insight out of employee recognition data. Routing bulk NER and extraction to a fine-tuned local Llama-3-8B instead of a pure LLM API cut model serving cost 10x with no quality loss.
